subtitle: Health & Fitness · diet · AI tag
verdict: A compact quiz funnel with an editable, sourced plan; the paywall ignores that plan and the reminder promise sits away from the price.

items.test: Put a dated Today / day 2 reminder / day 3 charge timeline under the annual price, and ask for notifications behind a sample reminder.
Let the user scan one meal (sample plate as fallback) and see it counted against the new target before the paywall.
items.evidence: Survey + trial lesson: +25% trial starts, +78% ARPU (#12, directional). Hypothesis here

items.test: Put the goal, target weight and daily calorie target in the paywall headline.
items.evidence: Flirt AI, answer-based paywalls: +20% trial-to-paid (#22, directional, confounded)

items.test: Open with one outcome screen (your plan from a photo in 2 minutes) before the workouts question.
items.evidence: Travel app, value proposition up front: +30% purchase conversion (#17, strong, bundled)

items.test: Ask lose / maintain / gain first and reuse it in the projection chart headline.
items.evidence: Headspace, quiz before the course: +7.6 pp course starts (#3, strong)

duration_note: Durations assume 2,000 installs a day, 8% install → trial and 3% install → paid, for a 10% relative change. Illustrative inputs.
